posts.content_text: Every student carries questions that don't appear in a textbook. "Sir, ek successful insaan kaun hota hai?" was one of them. During his surprise visit to PW Vidyapeeth, Ritik Sir interacted with Class 11 students from both our online and offline classrooms, turning the session into an open conversation.. Students asked what had been on their minds. From success and self-doubt to the journey ahead, Ritik Sir answered every question candidly, sharing perspectives shaped by his own experiences rather than textbook advice. A teacher's role goes far beyond completing a syllabus. Sometimes, the biggest takeaway isn't just an answer. It's knowing that every question is worth asking. Here's a glimpse of one such interaction. #PhysicsWallah #PWVidyapeeth #TeachingBeyondClassrooms #LearningTogether …more

posts.content_text: Are you building towards India’s big AI breakthrough? Whether you’re a student, a founder still finding your footing, or a startup already building for Bharat, this is for you. PW School of Startups has partnered with the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT) under the Startup India initiative, and the Government of Uttar Pradesh under its StartinUP initiative to launch the PW AI Startup Challenge, 2026. To support and accelerate the next wave of innovation, the challenge aims to fund and accelerate promising AI-driven startups and student innovators building solutions in: EdTech Healthcare & Robotic Surgery Defence Drones & Mobility FinTech B2B SaaS If you're building innovative AI-powered solutions in these sectors, this is an opportunity to showcase your work and explore funding support from PhysicsWallah. Apply now to be a part of Bharat's AI-led innovation economy. #PWSOS #Pwians #Startup #AI #physicswallah
